'''Grek Squad''' was a unit of [[GenoHaradan]], the secret bounty hunting organization. In [[3630 BBY]] the GenoHaradan were contracted to take out both Empress [[Darth Acina|Acina]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]]. Acina's [[Minister of Logistics]] [[Gelmid Lorman]] sabotaged her personal shuttle, causing it to crash in the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. However, both targets survived the crash and GenoHaradan went after for them. During the search, Grek Squad was hit by a lightning strike, which fried all of its members to a crisp.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=2}}</ref>
